title: Bouncy Bumps Into Everything
reason: Remove embedded sound-word dependence and strengthen the self-control lesson by having Bouncy stop, help repair mistakes, listen, and choose a safe place to bounce.

pages.1: Bouncy woke up and bounced into the cave wall. He stopped and rubbed his head.
pages.2: Bouncy bounced to the waterfall. He bumped into Fancy by mistake.
pages.3: "My sail!" cried Fancy. "I am sorry," said Bouncy. He stopped to check that she was all right.
pages.4: Next, Bouncy bumped into Wiggly. A basket of berries tipped over. They picked them up together.
pages.5: Then Bouncy bumped into Sneezy. Sneezy took a huge breath in.
pages.6: Sneezy sneezed. Leaves, berries, and Bossy's blank clipboard flew through the air.
pages.7: The Dino Pals looked at Bouncy. "I am sorry," he said. This time, he listened.
pages.8: "I need a safe place to bounce," said Bouncy. He went to the wide empty meadow and watched where he landed.
